title: Azure PR Review for OpenCode V2 settings

_help.description: Legacy documentation only, accepted for existing files. Omitted from new settings and removed during installation. Read README model-selection guidance instead; this field never affects model instructions.

functional.description: Exact provider/model ID for independent correctness review. Select for code comprehension, project language, boundary behavior, and regressions.

risk.description: Exact provider/model ID for independent risk review and comment planning. Select for cross-path failure analysis and reliable MCP tool use.

verifier.description: Exact provider/model ID for source-based verification, counterevidence, duplicate merging, and the final report. Select for evidence judgment, long context, and instruction following, not just summarization.

deep.description: Optional models for /pr-deep, which runs the same review as /pr-review with them: choose models stronger than models.review for the PRs that need them. Missing or empty roles disable deep mode; it never falls back to review models.

functional.description: Exact provider/model ID for independent correctness review. Select for code comprehension, project language, boundary behavior, and regressions. May be empty; deep runs only when all three IDs are configured.

risk.description: Exact provider/model ID for independent risk review and comment planning. Select for cross-path failure analysis and reliable MCP tool use. May be empty; deep runs only when all three IDs are configured.

verifier.description: Exact provider/model ID for source-based verification, counterevidence, duplicate merging, and the final report. Select for evidence judgment, long context, and instruction following, not just summarization. May be empty; deep runs only when all three IDs are configured.

quick.description: Optional quick profile for /pr-quick: one reviewer per shard covers functional and risk focus, with no independent verification. An empty reviewer disables /pr-quick; it never falls back to other models.

reviewer.description: Exact provider/model ID (optionally provider/model#variant) for the quick reviewer, which also plans comments for quick reviews. Select for code comprehension, evidence judgment and reliable tool use. May be empty.

outputLanguage.description: Language for human-facing initial and final reviews, comment bodies, skip reasons and AI attribution. IDs, JSON keys, code, paths, source quotes and severity tokens remain unchanged.

enabled.description: Save private stage inputs, visible answers, errors, and results locally. May contain confidential source or model-echoed secrets. Only the newest debug.keepRuns run directories are kept.

directory.description: Empty uses XDG_STATE_HOME/opencode/azpr-v2-debug (default ~/.local/state/opencode/azpr-v2-debug). Otherwise an absolute path or path relative to the active OpenCode project directory. No tilde expansion.

keepRuns.description: Run directories kept in the debug directory. When a run starts, older AZPR run directories beyond this count are deleted (never a run still active in this OpenCode process, and nothing AZPR did not create). 0 keeps every run directory.

runTimeoutSeconds.description: Optional whole-command timeout covering all stages. Null or omitted disables it; an integer from 10 to 7200 enables it. The deadline is not reset between stages. Manual /pr-stop and per-call MCP timeouts remain available. This is not a spending cap.

shell.description: Shell access for private reviewers and the comment planner. deny (default): shell is hidden and refused, so reviewers never run commands while reading untrusted PR content. ask: every command needs user approval in OpenCode (a background review waits for it). inherit: host permission rules decide.

progressNotices.description: Queue short PROGRESS notices to the invoking conversation during long reviews and publication. They never start a model response.

deletePrivateSessions.description: Delete AZPR's private reviewer sessions when they are no longer needed: a completed review's sessions when the review is evicted (the newest 20 are kept, as /pr-comment needs them), and the sessions of an unfinished review at once except the one holding its report or draft (all of them while debug is enabled); those kept sessions follow the same 20-run limit. false keeps every session.

afterReview.description: What AZPR does after a COMPLETE review of each mode. none (default): nothing; run /pr-comment yourself. preview: plan a comment preview as a separate command with its own receipt; planning uses a model and nothing is posted. publish: plan the comments and post them as the PAT owner; a comment whose text has an @mention, or outside literal code an image, HTML that embeds content, runs a script or hides text, or a javascript:, vbscript:, data: or file:// link, waits in the preview for a person, and nothing is posted when every finding is already discussed on the PR. Quick review comments are posted with their not-independently-verified disclosure. A review without findings to comment on gets neither. A flag right after the PR URL (--preview, --publish or --no-comment) overrides this for one run.

deep.description: After /pr-deep; its comments are planned with models.deep.risk.

azure.description: Azure DevOps REST access (api-version 7.1) shared by all AZPR workflows in one OpenCode process. No MCP server is used.

organization.description: Azure DevOps organization name: the <org> in https://dev.azure.com/<org>. PR URLs of other organizations are refused.

pat.description: Personal access token for that organization (scopes: Code Read; Pull Request Threads Read & write), or empty when azure.patFile names a file that holds it. Sent only to https://dev.azure.com/<org> and never logged. Keep this file private (mode 600).

patFile.description: Recommended: the absolute path of a file that holds only the PAT, so settings.json holds no secret. AZPR refuses the file unless you own it, it is a regular file (not a symbolic link) and only you may access it (mode 600). Leave azure.pat empty when you use it, and restart OpenCode after replacing the file.

concurrency.description: Simultaneous Azure DevOps calls across all AZPR workflows. This limits parallelism, never total work.

callTimeoutSeconds.description: Per-call timeout. A hung call is aborted and its slot released so other reviews keep running; reads are retried.

archiveMegabytes.description: Largest repository zip that content search (azpr_search_code) downloads per run and commit. A larger repository is not searched; the rest of the review is unaffected. The archive is held in memory while a review runs.

proxy.description: Forward proxy for AZPR's Azure DevOps calls only, e.g. http://proxy.example.com:8080; credentials go in the URL as http://user:password@host:port (percent-encoded) and are never shown. HTTPS requests are tunnelled with CONNECT, so the proxy sees the host name but not the PAT unless it inspects TLS. Empty: no AZPR proxy; HTTPS_PROXY and NO_PROXY in OpenCode's environment still apply.

caFile.description: Absolute path of a PEM file with CA certificates that AZPR trusts in addition to the built-in roots, for a proxy that inspects HTTPS. Read when OpenCode loads AZPR; restart OpenCode after changing it.

verifyTls.description: false turns off certificate checks for AZPR's Azure DevOps calls (like curl -k): anyone who can intercept the connection can then read the PAT. Last resort when the proxy's CA certificate cannot be obtained; prefer caFile. /pr-check shows a warning while it is off.

workflow.description: Review sharding, repair and retry behavior.

shardFiles.description: Changed files per initial-review session. A shard that hits its context limit is split automatically.

parallelSessions.description: Reviewer sessions running at the same time within one command.

repairAttempts.description: Correction turns in the same session when an answer does not meet the output contract. Remaining problems degrade per item.

stageRetries.description: New-session retries after a transient execution failure (provider 429/5xx, interrupted stream) or a stop by the inactivity watchdog.

stageIdleSeconds.description: Stage inactivity watchdog: a reviewer stage that shows no activity (prompt admission, model request, streamed output, tool start or end, approval request, announced host retry) for this many seconds while it waits on OpenCode is stopped with an error that says so (failure=idle) and retried in a new session (stageRetries). Any activity restarts the window, so long stages that keep working, including a long answer that keeps streaming, are never cut. 0 turns it off. With shell allowed, an approval or a command that takes longer counts as inactivity.
